subtopics.title: Data Quality
subtopics.summary: Ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and free from errors, analogous to using fresh ingredients in cooking, as poor data can cause model biases and hallucinations.

subtopics.title: Data Coverage
subtopics.summary: Ensuring the dataset has the right mix of diverse usage patterns and characteristics to represent all necessary scenarios without over- or under-representing specific types.

subtopics.title: Data Quantity
subtopics.summary: Determining the appropriate volume of data required for training, balancing the need for sufficient examples against resource constraints.

subtopics.title: Data Filtering and Deduplication
subtopics.summary: The process of removing low-quality samples and duplicate entries from raw data to build a clean dataset foundation.

subtopics.title: Overlap Analysis
subtopics.summary: Analyzing the intersection between different data subsets to prevent data leakage and ensure distinct training, validation, and test sets.
